unsubscribe.doneAll: You won’t get {business}’s marketing mail again.
unsubscribe.stillService: Mails about your own orders and visits still reach you.
unsubscribe.deadWrite: Write to {email} and we’ll take you off the list.
unsubscribe.deadAsk: Write to {business} and they’ll take you off the list.

confirm.note: Nothing happens until you press Confirm. You can unsubscribe from any e-mail we send.
confirm.leave: Every e-mail has a link to unsubscribe.
confirm.tooOldWebsite: Sign up again on {website} and we’ll send a new one.
confirm.tooOldAgain: Sign up again on {business}’s website and we’ll send a new one.
confirm.deadWrite: Write to {email} if you meant to sign up.
confirm.deadAsk: Write to {business} if you meant to sign up.

object.title: Object to {business} keeping your details?
object.line: {business} will delete your details and put this address on its do-not-email list.
object.done: Done. We have deleted your details and won’t write to you again.
object.stays: {business} keeps its own records that named you, with your details taken out: {records}.
object.already: You’ve already objected. {business} doesn’t keep your details.
object.dead: This link doesn’t work. Write to {email}.
object.deadAsk: This link doesn’t work. Write to {business}.

textConfirm.title: Get offers from {business} by text?
textConfirm.line: Press Confirm, and {business} may send you offers by text at this number. You can reply STOP to any of them to stop.
textConfirm.done: Confirmed. {business} may now send you offers by text.
textConfirm.stop: Reply STOP to any of them, and they stop.
textConfirm.withdrawn: This can’t be confirmed any more.
textConfirm.withdrawnLine: You’ll get no offers by text from {business} unless you agree again.
